title: Codebook translation table: version 2.5 to 2.7
background:
You chose on 30 October that an agent drafts the table that translates between the current production version (2.5) and the new version (2.7), and that you review it before signing.

Each card is one codebook item. **New → old** says how the old column is filled on new rows; **Old → new** says how an old row reads in the new terms. Where a translation would be a guess, the draft says *not mappable* rather than force one. Lines marked **Needs your decision** rest on no ruling or text (16 in all); each says what the alternative is.

No recommendation is given on the substance. The batch card at the top approves everything you leave unmarked.

items.title: Page verdict
items.situation:
The old four-value evidence column becomes the nine-value page verdict.

**2 line(s) need your decision.**
items.body:
**Old column:** `genai_evidence`

**New → old** (fills the old column on new rows):
- `confirms_activity` → `confirms_activity` (high certainty)
- `ambiguous_genai` → `ambiguous` (high certainty)
- `ambiguous_attribution` → `ambiguous` (high certainty)
- `background_only` → `background_only` (high certainty)
- `confirms_absence` → `confirms_absence` (high certainty)
- `no_genai` → `confirms_absence` (medium certainty) — Both v2.7 values collapse into the old absence code.
- `other_body` → not mappable (medium certainty) · **Needs your decision** — Old rules sent such pages to 'ambiguous' or 'background only' depending on the reading; no fixed choice.
- `event_only` → not mappable (medium certainty) · **Needs your decision** — Old rules could code an event page as an activity or as background; no fixed choice.
- `not_assessable` → not mappable (high certainty) — The old version wrote no row for an unreviewed page.

**Old → new** (for reading old rows):
- `confirms_activity` → `confirms_activity` (medium certainty) — Old positives may include pages v2.7 codes as event only or other body.
- `ambiguous` → not mappable (high certainty) — Splits into the two v2.7 ambiguous values; the old row does not say which.
- `background_only` → `background_only` (medium certainty) — May include pages v2.7 codes as other body.
- `confirms_absence` → not mappable (medium certainty) — The old meaning is v2.7 'no GenAI', but a page stating absence also took it.

**New in v2.7, no old counterpart:** `other_body`, `event_only`, `not_assessable`

Old rows stay unconverted (SPEC R-015); the reverse column is for reading old rows only.
